name: time-off-request
title: Time off request
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Pick a type, a date range, and a note. The summary counts business days and shows what would remain of the balance.

files.content:
"use client" /** * Absence request. Counts business days only and shows requested days against * the balance that is still free. The host owns submit and the holiday list. */ import * as React from "react" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input" import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, } from "@/components/ui/select" import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton" import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { balanceLeft, businessSpan, requestedUnits, type AbsencePortion, type Holiday } from "@/lib/time-off" export type AbsenceKind = { id: string label: string portion: AbsencePortion } export type TimeOffDraft = { kindId: string start: string end: string note: string requested: number remaining: number } export type TimeOffRequestLabels = { title: string kind: string start: string end: string note: string notePlaceholder: string summary: string requested: string available: string pending: string remaining: string skipped: string weekend: string shortfall: string none: string submit: string empty: string loading: string vacation: string personal: string sick: string half: string amount: (value: number) => string } const requestLabels: TimeOffRequestLabels = { title: "Request time away", kind: "Type", start: "From", end: "To", note: "Notes", notePlaceholder: "Optional", summary: "Requested days vs available balance", requested: "Requested", available: "Available", pending: "Already pending", remaining: "Would remain", skipped: "Not counted", weekend: "Weekend", shortfall: "The balance does not cover this request.", none: "That range has no business day.", submit: "Send request", empty: "There is no balance to request against.", loading: "Loading the request", vacation: "Vacation", personal: "Personal", sick: "Sick", half: "Half day", amount: (value) => String(value), } export function defaultAbsenceKinds(labels: Pick): AbsenceKind[] { return [ { id: "vacation", label: labels.vacation, portion: "day" }, { id: "personal", label: labels.personal, portion: "day" }, { id: "sick", label: labels.sick, portion: "day" }, { id: "half", label: labels.half, portion: "half" }, ] } export type TimeOffRequestProps = { available?: number | null pending?: number holidays?: readonly Holiday[] kinds?: readonly AbsenceKind[] defaultKindId?: string defaultStart?: string defaultEnd?: string defaultNote?: string loading?: boolean error?: string onSubmit?: (draft: TimeOffDraft) => void labels?: Partial className?: string } export function TimeOffRequest({ available = null, pending = 0, holidays = [], kinds, defaultKindId, defaultStart = "", defaultEnd = "", defaultNote = "", loading = false, error, onSubmit, labels: labelOverrides, className, }: TimeOffRequestProps) { const labels = { ...requestLabels, ...labelOverrides } const options = kinds ?? defaultAbsenceKinds(labels) const [kindId, setKindId] = React.useState(defaultKindId || options[0]?.id || "vacation") const [start, setStart] = React.useState(defaultStart) const [end, setEnd] = React.useState(defaultEnd) const [note, setNote] = React.useState(defaultNote) const kind = options.find((item) => item.id === kindId) ?? options[0] const portion = kind?.portion ?? "day" const span = start ? businessSpan(start, portion === "half" ? start : end || start, holidays) : null const requested = start ? requestedUnits(start, end || start, holidays, portion) : 0 const remaining = available == null ? null : balanceLeft(available, pending, requested) const blocked = requested <= 0 || (remaining != null && remaining < 0) function submit(event: React.FormEvent) { event.preventDefault() if (blocked || available == null || !kind) return onSubmit?.({ kindId: kind.id, start, end: portion === "half" ? start : end || start, note, requested, remaining: remaining ?? 0, }) } return (

meta.descriptionEs: Tipo, rango y notas. El resumen cuenta solo días hábiles y muestra lo que quedaría del saldo.

examples.title: Vacaciones de septiembre
examples.description: Del 14 al 18 el 16 de septiembre no se descuenta.

api.name: available / pending / holidays
api.description: Null available is empty. Holidays are ISO dates with a name.

api.name: kinds
api.description: Defaults are vacation, personal, sick, and half day. Half day counts 0.5 and hides the end date.

api.name: onSubmit
api.description: Disabled when nothing is countable or the balance would go negative.

api.name: labels
api.description: English chrome. The summary is requested days versus available balance.

docs: Counts with time-off-core. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite button, input, select, skeleton, or textarea. github.com/kargulstudio/calender-app-design (MIT) was a behavior reference only; no source was copied.
